steps.observation: Work on this for 300 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Three major causes of World War I were:

1. Militarism  
   European powers built up large, modern armies and navies and adopted plans (e.g. Germany’s Schlieffen Plan) that emphasized rapid mobilization and offensive war. This arms race made the outbreak of a general conflict more likely.

2. Alliance Systems  
   A web of binding treaties (notably the Triple Alliance of Germany–Austria-Hungary–Italy vs. the Triple Entente of France–Russia–Britain) meant that any localized dispute could—and eventually did—drag all the great powers into war.

3. Imperialism and Nationalism  
   Competition for overseas colonies (especially in Africa and Asia) and rising nationalist movements in multiethnic empires (like Slavic nationalism in the Balkans) fueled rivalries and crises that set the stage for a larger European war.
